name: processtask_step
label: Work Order Steps Table
description: The work order steps table is used for tracking process-related statuses, enabling status filtering, and querying related data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Node types, with different types of nodes having different flow behaviors.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Status: 1 for activated, 0 for not handled, -1 for not processed, 2 for completed.

fields.name: active_time
fields.description: Activation time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_active_time
indexes.description: Standard index covering the active_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_processtask_id_active
indexes.description: Standard index covering the processtask_id, is_active fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_processtask_id_status
indexes.description: Standard index covering the processtask_id, status fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
